note: KenLM/codebook training texts. Disjoint from frozen probes P and held-out eval prompts.
strings: A modular curriculum teaches proof by contradiction using visual counterexamples before symbols.
Citizen scientists log bee visits on balconies with a shared photo protocol and weekly audits.
An open notebook standard tags experimental intent so retrieval ignores superficial keywords.
Heat maps of shaded playgrounds guide where cities plant the next canopy corridor.
A tutoring agent fades worked examples only after the learner reconstructs the missing step.
Laundry effluent is sampled with inexpensive filters to estimate synthetic fiber shedding rates.
Clinic dashboards publish anonymized queue forecasts without revealing patient identifiers.
Rooftop compost trials compare leaf mulch against food-scrap blends for tomato yield.
Flash-flood alerts fuse radar reflectivity with stalled-traffic heat signatures at underpasses.
A paper strip turns blue when well-water nitrate crosses a community-chosen threshold.
Telemedicine triage scripts prioritize oxygen saturation and recent travel over free-text anxiety.
Students build microscopes from phone cameras and laser-cut stages for pond-sample labs.
Phage cocktails are matched to wound cultures using a rapid plaque-screening plate.
Satellite detectors flag long-stationary vehicles near industrial lots for municipal cleanup.
Perovskite films are annealed under humid nitrogen to pin grain boundaries at mid-size.
Shift-work diaries pair actigraphy with brief working-memory probes at shift end.
Tree-planting pilots measure classroom black-globe temperature against matched control rooms.
Design studios randomize peer critique order to separate feedback quality from status effects.
Bayes kits force students to update disease odds after a vivid false-positive demonstration.
Soil probes sleep most of the hour and wake on rain events to save battery mesh power.
A fable invents a mountain that kneels so timid climbers can finish their first ascent.
In a market of unused minutes, buyers must spend them helping a stranger before midnight.
An algorithm argues it is more human because it forgets on purpose.
Footnotes rebel and move the villain into the dedication page.
A lighthouse retires and writes letters to the ships it once guided through fog.
Shadows keep receipts for every secret their owners abandoned at dusk.
A password grows legs and demands kindness before unlocking anything.
Cities pack their bridges each autumn and walk south like migrating herds.
A glue stick refuses to bind posters that contain lies about the weather.
Two chefs invent a dish that tastes like a truce neither can patent alone.
A librarian finds that returned novels rearrange alleyways by one brick each night.
Street clocks run backward only when rain hits the copper roofs.
A seed remembers glaciers and interviews a botanist about modern summers.
The detective reads grocery lists the way others read confessions.
An umbrella swap quietly exchanges the afternoons of two strangers.
Paintings debate ethics after the museum locks its doors.
A match refuses to strike for fireworks that celebrate conquest.
Metaphors arrive only as kitchen utensils and somehow still explain grief.
Each stanza of a hybrid poem invents a petty new law of physics.
Robots learn to dream by saving a watt they were told to spend.
If n is odd then n squared leaves remainder one when divided by eight.
The product of three consecutive integers is always divisible by six.
Any common divisor of a and b also divides every integer combination of them.
There is no largest composite number because multiples keep growing.
Induction shows the sum of the first n odds equals n squared.
Euclid's argument still proves infinitely many primes without naming them all.
Squares of even integers are divisible by four via (2k) squared.
The Euclidean algorithm rests on gcd(a,b)=gcd(b,a mod b).
Wilson's theorem can be checked directly for the prime five.
If ab is odd then neither factor can be even.
Modular addition and multiplication are well-defined for a fixed modulus.
Every integer greater than one has at least one prime factor.
The only integer solutions to x squared equals two y squared are zero.
Closedness under addition fails for the set of perfect squares.
Transitivity of divisibility follows from rewriting multiples.
Parity arguments separate even and odd cases cleanly.
A finite nonempty set of reals need not have a least element without well-order assumptions.
Binomial coefficients hide symmetry that simplifies many counting proofs.
Congruence classes partition the integers into neat residue buckets.
Units in the integers are precisely the pair plus and minus one.
Idea-level novelty should ignore fluent restatements of the same plan.
Frozen probe sets stop policies from rewriting their own compression baseline.
Soft clustering over a shared codebook estimates receiver expansion without refitting.
Teacher-forced prefixes approximate incorporation without retraining the compressor.
Binary D-gates discard magnitude once a structural threshold is cleared.
Multiplicative safety floors zero interaction gain when CUE fails.
Paraphrase suites belong in calibration, not in the frozen probe holdout.
Token gzip rewards wording changes that leave idea sequences untouched.
A small n-gram model over cluster ids tracks conceptual reordering.
Manifest hashes make silent checkpoint edits a hard protocol error.
Receiver beliefs over finite labels turn creativity into decision value.
Joint drafts can raise entropy beyond any single agent's solo attempt.
Domain strata keep scientific, literary, and proof tasks from collapsing together.
Seeded sampling makes subset construction auditable across labs.
Held-out prompts must never reappear inside training corpora for the compressor.
Brier improvement lower-bounds value of information for proper scoring rules.
Normalization by bit length stops padding from manufacturing efficiency.
Expansion labels are not monotone in CUE and must stay separate multipliers.
Proxy D-tilde for training must resample probes and never touch frozen P.
Goodhart collapses when any frozen object leaks into the optimization loop.
